description: This Java class defines a fragment for an Android app's setup wizard, specifically handling the enabling of a keyboard. It manages UI interactions, system setting observations, and navigation to system settings or main app settings.

classes.name: WizardPageEnableKeyboardFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages the UI and logic for enabling a keyboard in the setup wizard, including observing system settings and navigating to system input method settings.

methods.name: getPageLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout resource ID for this fragment's UI.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets click listeners, and starts observing system settings changes.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes context and intent for relaunching the setup wizard activity.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Prepares the fragment when it becomes visible, including removing pending messages and unregistering observers.

methods.name: refreshFragmentUi
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect whether the keyboard is enabled.

methods.name: isStepCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the keyboard setup step has been completed.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters observers.

methods.name: unregisterSettingsObserverNow
methods.description: Removes message callbacks and disposes of the settings observer subscription.
